text: This report recommends approval of a Rental Housing Demolition application which proposes to demolish a three-storey apartment building containing 17 rental dwelling units located at 11 Churchill Avenue. The 17 rental units are proposed to be replaced as part of the new development on the site. The proposal includes a Tenant Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and provides financial compensation to mitigate hardship. The properties at 5318-5324 Yonge Street and 11 Churchill Avenue are the subject of a Zoning By-law Amendment application (22 193284 NNY 18 OZ), which was appealed to the Ontario Land Tribunal (OLT).
